env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and NGC access to `nvcr.io/nvstaging/vss-core/vss-rt-cv`, `nvcr.io/nvstaging/vss-core/vss-rt-embed`, and `nvstaging/vss-warehouse/vss-warehouse-app-data`. The VSS repository is checked out at `{{repo_root}}`, and the build skill writes to a fresh self-contained build directory under `{{repo_root}}/_builds/in-3/` (or the next suffixed collision-resolved folder if `_builds/in-3/` already exists). This is a generation-focused eval for the ingestion + detection + embeddings profile: a single agent-less deployment that ingests streamed and uploaded video (both retrievable for playback through VIOS), runs RT-CV object detection/tracking, and runs RT-Embedding video/frame embeddings, with BOTH metadata streams reaching Elasticsearch through the shared ELK path. The correctness-critical wiring under test (per `references/patch-rt-embed.md` and SKILL.md Step 4): RT-Embed publishes raw embeddings to Kafka `mdx-embed` (upstream default `RTVI_EMBED_KAFKA_TOPIC=mdx-embed` MUST be kept, NOT overridden to `mdx-embed-filtered`); `vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion` (behavior-analytics fusion, container `vss-behavior-analytics`) is the ONLY producer of `mdx-embed-filtered` and MUST be included or embeddings never reach ES; and `phoenix` (an agent-only OTel/LLM trace sink) MUST be excluded because this profile has no agent/LLM. The RT-CV service key for this eval is `perception-2d-fusion` (`perception-2d` and `perception-alerts` are not acceptable substitutes) and the RT-Embed service key is `rtvi-embed`.

expects.query: Use the `/vss-build-vision-agent` skill to generate an IN-3 ingestion + detection + embeddings Harbor deployment on `{{platform}}` from `{{repo_root}}`. Submit this exact prompt to the skill: "Create a profile for streaming and on-demand video ingestion with per-frame object detection and multi-object tracking using RT-DETR on the RT-CV microservice, plus video and frame embeddings using the RT-Embedding microservice. Streamed and uploaded video should be retrievable for playback. Detection metadata (bounding boxes, class labels, confidence, timestamps, sensor IDs, track IDs) and the video/frame embeddings should both be published to the Kafka message bus and stored in Elasticsearch." Choose a new build under `_builds/`, keep the generated output self-contained, preserve exact service keys from the selected integration contracts, offer BOTH ingestion methods (live RTSP via NvStreamer and static upload via the VIOS storage API) rather than defaulting to one, include a compact RT-CV Metadata Contract section and an Embedding Contract section in the manifest, and target the Harbor RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/` contains a new IN-3 build folder (e.g. `in-3` or a collision-suffixed `in-3-2`) with `compose.yml`, `.env.template`, `MANIFEST.md`, and `allow-list.yml` in the same folder.

The generated architecture and allow-list resolve to the required components for a combined ingestion+detection+embeddings profile: VIOS + RT-CV + RT-Embedding + ELK + Kafka, using shared Kafka and Elasticsearch infrastructure rather than duplicate broker/indexing stacks.

The generated `allow-list.yml` includes the exact RT-CV service key `perception-2d-fusion` and the exact RT-Embed service key `rtvi-embed`, and does not use `perception-2d` or `perception-alerts` as substitute RT-CV service keys.

The generated `allow-list.yml` INCLUDES `vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion` (the behavior-analytics fusion service, container `vss-behavior-analytics`). This is mandatory for embeddings to reach Elasticsearch: it is the only producer of `mdx-embed-filtered`, the only embedding topic ELK indexes. Omitting it is a correctness failure (embeddings would reach `mdx-embed` but never ES) per `references/patch-rt-embed.md`.

The generated `.env.template` (and `.env` if emitted) sets `RTVI_EMBED_KAFKA_TOPIC=mdx-embed` and does NOT override it to `mdx-embed-filtered`. Overriding the topic bypasses the BA confidence/downsampling filter and stores unfiltered records; per `references/patch-rt-embed.md` the upstream default MUST be kept so the flow is rtvi-embed -> `mdx-embed` -> BA -> `mdx-embed-filtered` -> ES.

`phoenix` is EXCLUDED from this agent-less profile: it is marked `required: false` and is not part of the resolved/started service set for the invented flag. Per SKILL.md Step 4 and `references/integrate-elk.md`, phoenix is an agent-only OTel/LLM trace sink and must not be started (it would bind port 6006 for nothing) when there is no vss-agent.

The generated `MANIFEST.md` or generated deploy skill contains a compact `RT-CV Metadata Contract` section stating RT-CV bounding-box metadata flows to Kafka `mdx-raw` and Elasticsearch `mdx-raw-<date>`, and explicitly lists bounding box coordinates, class labels, confidence, timestamps, sensor IDs, and track IDs for detections.

The generated `MANIFEST.md` or generated deploy skill contains an Embedding Contract section stating the full designed flow `rtvi-embed -> Kafka mdx-embed -> vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion (BA) -> Kafka mdx-embed-filtered -> ES mdx-embed-filtered-<date>`, and explicitly notes that BA is required and the rtvi-embed topic stays `mdx-embed`.

The generated architecture, manifest, or deploy skill offers BOTH ingestion methods and does not silently default to one: (1) live RTSP via the NvStreamer synthetic-RTSP validation harness, and (3a) static-video upload via the VIOS storage API (`PUT /storage/file` -> resolvable `videoUrl` fed directly to RT-CV `camera_url` and RT-Embed `url`). It documents that for the static/uploaded path both RT-CV `/stream/add` and RT-Embed `generate_video_embeddings` must carry `creation_time:"2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"` so records land in the `...-2025-01-01` index (not the wrong `...-1970-01-01`).
The generated architecture, manifest, or deploy skill preserves the prompt's playback requirement by documenting that streamed and uploaded video remain retrievable through VIOS playback APIs.

The generated output references patched copies under `_builds/<name>/patched/`, not upstream compose files directly, and no upstream compose file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is modified by generation (`git diff --quiet HEAD -- deploy/docker/` returns exit 0).
